papers.title: Automated analysis of feline posture using deep learning and geometric modeling.
papers.authors: Bezerra CE, Bittencourt C, Alves R, Ribeiro T, Azorín-Ortuño M
papers.abstract: Body posture provides clinically relevant information in cats, but behavioral interpretation can be challenging because postural signs are often subtle, context-dependent, and subject to inter-observer variability.
